name: Camping Sebastian Huber
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Sebastian Huber is located in the quiet village of Söchtenau in Tirol. The site offers close-to-nature surroundings and is suitable for guests seeking relaxation in the Alpen. On the grounds, parcelled pitches are available for motorhomes and tents. Sanitary facilities and electricity connections are available. In the surrounding area, hiking trails and cycling routes invite you to get active. The site is a suitable starting point for excursions to the nearby Inntal.
